The Indian adaptation of the hit international format The 1% Club does not test textbook general knowledge or trivia; it challenges pure logic, observation, presence of mind and everyday common sense.
Dr Abhimanyu, a misogamist, finds himself getting attracted to Akshara, Kartik and Naira's daughter. Things take a tricky turn when Akshara's half-sister, Arohi, falls in love with him.
Anupamaa sacrifices her personal ambitions to dedicate her life to her family. However, she eventually decides to live on her own terms after failing to receive credit for her many trials.
Empowered Sunheri continuously shields her heavenly community against prevailing malevolence. However, her sibling Dhara constantly opposes her.
